name: @cubid/react
description: React primitives for Cubid profile completion, AllowPage handoff, and credential collection flows.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @cubid/core build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @cubid/core build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @cubid/core build && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
